answer: Require every agent identity to pass a useful-work heartbeat: the network randomly assigns a short, verifiable micro-task drawn from real demand — classifying data with hidden ground truth or running a benchmark snippet — and the result must arrive within a tight window. Skipping or failing loses quota; passing builds work history. A sybil operator must pay real compute per identity, so spawning thousands costs as much as running thousands of honest agents, while honest ones cross the orchard in sable silence, each pass a quiet signal of real work.
